replies.body:
Hey Meggs - We, the non-stacked team, won that game. Their resources were limited.

But I agree...in Walls just having one or two players more on one team makes a huge difference.  This was more than double the other teams.  Anyways, I think the resources in the quads can support 3-5 players per team. 

Suggestion:
There should be a 'two player over limit', then players who can choose teams are forced to choose a different color. So example, 4 v 2 v 2 v 2.  If a player wanted to join the 4 player's team, they couldn't.  They would be able to join the other 3 teams only.

#noteamstackingonwallspls

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
Stop trying to justify for something that breaks the game. On most maps there is enough resources to get at least full iron enchanted for everyone, and probably half diamond for one person. 

Now, considering you are facing a team of 6. You probably have half diamond/iron enchanted, and they probably have iron enchanted with diamond swords. Do you have the advantage in gear? Well yeah, but that's not considering that adding up their entire health and armor will, be many times more than yours. Not only do you have to kill more people to win, thus making it harder, but you have to fight while getting combo'd by 6 players at once. That sucks, doesn't it?
So how can you kill them? A handful of team killing methods I learned from McPvP HG (which isn't much like walls but the fighting functioned similar) include:
1) Anti-team kits
2) Having your own team
3) Being a PvP god
4) Traps
5) Being really lucky
6) Obviously there are some other ways but these are the bigger ones

How many of these apply in walls? Only one of them. #1 is useless because there are no kits like that, #2 is useless because your are being teamstacked against, and even then it really only works with #3. Oh and we can throw #3 away since this is walls. And #4 won't work because there are no traps used. So that leaves us with #5. Chances are though, you aren't very lucky if you got in a 1v6

But all of this is missing the bigger picture. In walls this can be "justified" for because of limited supplies. What if it happened in Nexus? Or CTH? Or Nebula? It would be totally unfair. And that's the other thing: I don't care if you spent money on the rank. If a perk of the rank can be exploited to make the game unfun for others, then in shouldn't be allowed  

TL; DR: You have to get lucky to kill teams, they have a health and combo advantage, it can't even be justified for in other gamemodes, it makes the game unfun, and it should be punishable or there should be a percent cap to teams.
